description: Get the cancellation terms stored for one TripWays tour by bokun_id: the type (free, flexible, partial, or non_refundable), the refund percent and cutoff when the tour has them, and the operator's policy text. These are the tour's terms, not a quote for a specific booking.
name: get_cancellation_policy

cutoff.description: How long before the start the terms apply.

error.description: Present when ok is false. code: tour_not_found, destination_not_found, destination_ambiguous, or unpriced. message is written for the traveler.

title: Get cancellation policy
